rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a full blastocyst and acknowledges intact zona, but overstates certainty about ICM/TE being clearly excellent from the image alone and localizes the ICM inaccurately; some described details (no fragmentation, cohesive TE throughout) are not confidently discernible.
Thoroughly integrates age, BMI, ovarian reserve, semen parameters, endometrium, first-cycle status, and lack of PGT-A with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with a clear link from embryo quality and patient factors to prognosis; minor overprecision in quantitative adjustments and some speculative statements reduce perfection.

Mostly aligned on SET and general IVF counseling, but includes less guideline-based suggestions such as routine assisted hatching discussion, thrombophilia workup/chronic endometritis evaluation after a first failure, and strong claims about BMI-specific progesterone monitoring.
Provides clear practical recommendations for transfer, lifestyle modification, and future planning, though a few suggestions are more speculative than standard and could be better prioritized.
